messages:
maria_cs: Heads-up — Riverbank renewal sits on signer + vendor code. Procurement told me they need a PO, but customer prefers CC. Need decision by Fri EOD or we'll miss the renewal window. DocSend w/ latest SOW: https://docsend.com/view/riverbank-renewal-v2 :eyes:

sam_se: Do we need KMS/HSM clause for their Private deployment? I remember they asked about key separation earlier this quarter.

jordan_am: maria — can you paste the billing entity (legal name + tax id)? Procurement won't issue vendor code without it.

maria_cs: billing entity is `Riverbank Systems, Inc.` — taxid on file ends with 8273, i'll reconfirm full EIN with legal. They signed the Dedicated addendum but didn't opt into KMS yet.

nicole_proc: if it's a PO we need vendor code + remit address. If CC, we can bypass vendor code but need cardholder approval (procurement flagged fraud review). leaning towards PO on our side.

rose_legal: if they opt into KMS, legal needs this sentence added to Sec Exhibit B: "Customer-managed keys will be retained in customer KMS and Redwood will not persist plaintext keys." Can someone confirm whether customer requires HSM-backed keys?

maria_cs: I can ask them now. Next steps: (1) confirm PO vs CC, (2) confirm KMS opt-in, (3) collect signer name + email. I'll ping the customer this afternoon.

jordan_am: i'll escalate to the buyer. also flag: they asked for a 9-month term instead of 12 — pricing asked for a 10% uplift to accept shorter term. need approval or we push standard 12.

sam_se: 10% uplift aligns with our churn model; approved from pre-signed guidance. cc @pricing-team

pricing-team: noted. please attach final SOW with term change before we push invoice.

maria_cs: thanks. i'll return with signer info and PO vs CC. if they go PO, can procurement expedite vendor code? @nicole_proc

nicole_proc: can do, but we need vendor docs (W9 or equivalent + remit address) by tomorrow morning to hit Friday. send to procurement@redwood.com and i'll triage.

esign-bot: Signature request created for Riverbank Renewal (SOW_v2) — awaiting signer: laura@riverbank.com

maria_cs: perfect — i'll confirm laura is the authorized sig. tl;dr: on track if vendor docs + KMS decision in 24h. :thumbsup:
